name: Atomic Blastman
description:
About This Game

Game Summary

I know, you know, we all know that sometimes you miss something but you can't really put your finger on it. Maybe today is a bit different than what it used to be, maybe it's about things that have been and are not anymore. Maybe it's about that Sunday afternoon when you used to play a LAN match with your father in the arena. Maybe it is indeed about nostalgia. There we go, I KNEW IT!

Atomic Blastman isn't here to replace any of those sweet memories, but rather to bring the memories and nostalgia back and a whole lot more. Launch Atomic Blastman, pick your favorite color, suit yourself with your best cosmetics and jump right into the arena. Blast and blow everything and everyone up except... well... YOU. Be careful and do it quickly or survive a sudden death rain. Be it a solo match, a couch 1v1 with your father, a LAN match with your friends, or a whole gaming night with your long-distance partner, Atomic Blastman has a way to connect you with those you love.

AND REMEMBER: be the last one standing to earn a bonus power-up and extra XP, giving you a head start when you jump back into the arena later, just like in the good old days...

Gameplay Features

  • Huge arenas, up to 100 x 100

  • Two main game modes: Battle Royale (health-based) and Classic (bombs instantly kill players)

  • Matches with up to 32 players, depending on game mode

  • Up to 15 power-ups, depending on game mode including both passive and active abilities like bomb punching, throwing, kicking, danger-zone visualizer, spreadable diseases, and many more

  • Sudden death mechanic. You just didn't think the matches would last forever, did you?

  • AI bots driven by a complex neural network capable of training after each round

Online Features

  • Crossplay between Epic and Steam, so everyone can play together no matter the platform. This implies the use of a single online subsystem, also known as EOS or Epic Online Services. However, This DOES NOT mean you need an Epic account to play Atomic Blastman. When launching the game for the first time, you will be prompted to fill out your linked Epic account details, account which will be silently used in the background. Everything else stays the same, including your Steam username and data.

  • Just for online matches, the game has a leaver punishment system to prevent players from quitting early. I won't tell you what it does and you should NOT find out by yourself

  • Atomic Blastman is based on a Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Unreal Engine architecture. Basically, it has no game servers. The longer the distance from the Host, the higher the client latency

  • Host, Join, or Queue to jump right into a random match after selecting the search filters

  • As the community heavily requested, the game will NOT be protected by any Anti-Cheat module.

Custom Map Editor

  • Place any cube you want, anywhere you want

  • Drop any power-up you want exactly where you want it to spawn

  • Each arena skin comes with its own cube variations. Pick and paint with any of them

  • Build arenas using custom objects you’ve unlocked or purchased from the in-game shop

  • Create, load, update, and delete any map you’ve stored

  • Or generate a random map instantly and start editing from there

  • The load widget shows an exact and pixelated thumbnail of the arena you are about to load

 The Atomic Blastman In-Game Shop

(Atomic Blastman offers style, not power! Everything in the shop is cosmetic only)

  • Full customization for the whole game: arenas, character skins, death animations, emotes, icons, banners, game themes, player intros, and more

  • Earn XP by playing matches and spend it directly in the shop

  • While some items can be purchased with regular XP, others can be purchased only with BC (Blast Coins), the official Atomic Blastman currency. The shop INCLUDES microtransactions for players who want to pick things up faster

  • Atomic Blastman DOES NOT AND WILL NOT handle any credit card information. We only handle the payment notification. Everything else is handled through Steam or PayPal, depending the platform you are playing on

  • The store is regularly updated with new assets, featured items and who knows, maybe even seasonal offers

Join Our Discord Server

  • We also set up a nice Discord server for the entire community – chat about our games and get in touch with the team. We’d love to have you there.

  • State your feedback and have a clear impact on the development journey of our games.

  • Be the first one to find out about our studio roadmap and future plans.

  • Join through social media or Steam links, or through the footer on our website.

Feeling nostalgic yet? So what are you waiting for? Wishlist Atomic Blastman, and let's bring the memories back
short_desc: Remember those epic LAN afternoons with your dad or friends? Atomic Blastman brings them back. Pick a color, suit up, and blast your way through huge arenas. Power-ups, sudden death, chaos, and laughs guaranteed. Just... please... don’t blow yourself up! Chaos and madness, guaranteed.
